title: dynamic-batching: sequence-length bucketing and padding-minimization heuristics (v20)
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: reduce wasted padding and improve throughput under skewed sequence-length workloads by introducing a lightweight, histogram-driven bucketing and padding-minimization heuristic integrated with the continuous batching scheduler. Changes include: 1) new seqlen histogram collector in runtime that maintains per-worker recent distribution; 2) Greedy bucketing algorithm that picks bucket boundaries to minimize total padded tokens subject to a target latency SLO; 3) A fast padding-minimizer that shuffles short requests into in-flight batches when it improves token-efficiency without violating SLOs; 4) Kernel-selection hints: updated kernel_selector to prefer kernels optimized for grouped-seqlen batches (reduced memory copies); 5) KV cache prefetch hooks to warm KV segments for buckets expected to be reused; 6) telemetry: per-bucket metrics, wasted_tokens, effective_batch_size, seqlen_p90/p50; 7) docs and perf benchmarks. Benchmarks: in mixed-length webchat workload (token-length distribution with 60% short <64, 30% medium 64-256, 10% long >256) we measured ~11% throughput improvement at 99ms p50 latency constraint and ~18% reduction in padded tokens versus v19 heuristics. Backwards compatibility: heuristic is opt-in via scheduler config flag "seqlen_bucketing=v20". Includes comprehensive unit and e2e perf tests. Checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] e2e perf tests - [x] docs update - [x] benchmarks attached - [x] Linear tasks linked - [x] config flag gated Rollout plan: enable in Canary across Dedicated pool, monitor per-bucket metrics for 48h, then global rollout. See ENG-3124 for rollout milestones.

review_comments: Eliot Zhang: Can we add a safety cap so greedy bucketer cannot create a single huge bucket that starves latency-sensitive traffic? Reply: added 'max_bucket_span_ms' config and a guard in the solver (see dyn_batcher.py).

Carlos Fernandez: Microbenchmark looks good but I'm worried about memory pressure on small GPU instances. Reply: added kernel-selection hints to pick kernels that avoid an extra temp buffer; also added perf test on g4dn-like machine (results attached).
Aisha Khan: Please include a canary rollout plan and telemetry gaps. Reply: added rollout paragraph in description and instrumented per-bucket metrics (wasted_tokens, hit_rate).

Reviewer CI: perf-regression check initially failed on long-sequence synthetic test; author: fixed padding-minimizer edge-case where reorder could increase p99 - added an SLO-aware reorder limiter and re-ran benchmarks.
merge_outcome: Merged to main with squash commit after reviewers approved. No hotfix required post-merge.
release_notes: Improved dynamic batching heuristics: sequence-length bucketing and padding minimization reduce padded tokens and increase throughput for mixed-length workloads. Opt-in via scheduler config 'seqlen_bucketing=v20'.
notes_for_ops: Enable seqlen_bucketing=v20 in canary Dedicated pool only. Monitor metrics: scheduler.seqlen.wasted_tokens, scheduler.bucket.effective_batch_size, scheduler.latency_slo_violations. Rollback flag: scheduler.seqlen_bucketing=off.
bench_summary: Mixed-length webchat benchmark: ~11% throughput gain and ~18% padded-token reduction vs v19 under target latency SLO; p99 latency unchanged within noise. See attached JSON for per-bucket numbers.
